title: Upwind Raises $400M Series C After Turning Down Datadog Offer
excerpt: Cloud security startup Upwind secured a $400 million Series C funding round at a $3.8 billion valuation instead of pursuing an acquisition.
body_html:
Cloud security startup Upwind has secured $400 million in a Series C funding round. The investment values the company at $3.8 billion.

The financing comes after the firm decided against accepting an acquisition offer from Datadog, which had proposed the same financial valuation.
